in_arabic.name: حين
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الحياء و العيش
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم من أصل عربي مشتق من كلمة الحياء و العيش، يدل على الرزق الحسن و العيش الرفيع، و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَوْرَاةِ وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِن بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدٌ وَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْعِشْرُونَ وَالْحَيَاةُ لِقَطْعِ الدَهْرِ

in_urdu.name: حین
in_urdu.meaning: حیاء و عیش سے متعلق، اچھا رزق
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی मूल کا نام، حیاء اور عیش سے نکلا ہوا ہے، اچھے رزق اور بلند عیش کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں روایتی استعمال

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name Haeen holds a significant cultural value as it translates to being 'graceful' in Urdu. In many Muslim societies, giving children beautiful and meaningful names is an essential custom. A graceful name such as Haeen conjures up positive emotions and instills a sense of beauty and elegance in the child as they grow up. Moreover, it is believed that a name holds an influential role in shaping a child's identity and personality, and Haeen, with its connotation of grace, is undoubtedly an empowering name that only contributes positively to its bearer's social journey.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the Islamic name Haeen holds deeper meanings and significance. In various Islamic sources and Sufi poetry, 'haeen' is considered a synonym for 'hayatur' – a term that denotes the eternal and ethereal nature of existence. Spiritually, the name Haeen symbolizes the eternal grace and mercy that emanate from Allah (swt), and it is a constant reminder to the bearer to remain steadfast on the path of pleasing Allah. By incorporating the name Haeen into one's identity, one is being granted a daily reminder of seeking divine grace, and striving to be a source of positivity and elegance in the world. In Sufi practices, repeating the name Yaa Haeeen (O possessor of grace) during meditation or prayer sessions can stimulate an outpouring of inner beauty and spiritual peace. At its essence, the name Haeen offers a connection between the person and the divine, encouraging them to live with grace, humility, and ultimate submission to Allah.
